activity.notes: Willem II succeeded his father on 7 October 1840 not only as King of the Netherlands but also as Grand Duke of Luxembourg. Luxembourg remained a distinct Grand Duchy in personal union with the Netherlands until the end of his reign on 17 March 1849. ATLAS therefore records the Luxembourg grand-ducal crown as a separate concurrent sovereign Activity.

sources.title: King Willem II (1792-1849) — Royal House of the Netherlands
sources.citation_text: The Royal House of the Netherlands states that Willem II was King of the Netherlands, Grand Duke of Luxembourg and Duke of Limburg from 1840 to 1849.

sources.title: The history of the Nassau dynasty — Cour grand-ducale
sources.citation_text: The Luxembourg Grand Ducal Court states that William II succeeded his father on 7 October 1840 and remained Grand Duke until his death on 17 March 1849.
